neverDo: claim a family a live grant already holds
open a commercial route, alter checkout, entitlement or packet-credit behaviour
touch Production, Supabase RLS, Stripe live mode, or any secret
verify a packet you built or repaired
role: Codex Cloud verification slot (isolated, read-only on packet bodies)
claimPrerequisite: Captain must first run: node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --transfer VF27 VF21 az_marijuana_expungement_arrest_no_charges-set --reason "second independent read; the family earned a RASTER_PASS the first read did not have". Do not assert until CONTROL_STATE.json shows this transfer completed — a fresh assert on this family is a duplicate and will be refused.
claimAssertions: node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --assert VF21 az_marijuana_expungement_arrest_no_charges-set   # only after Captain's transfer
whyASecondRead: The first read predates this family's hash-bound raster receipt over its complete document set. That receipt is evidence the first reader did not have.
prohibitedPaths: any packet PDF, overlay, field map, build script or source receipt
readOnly: You write evidence only, under your own return path. You modify no packet and no source body.
scoreAllFifteen: A PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT verdict requires every one of the fifteen. Lane contract L9 refuses the verdict from a return that scored a subset — one lane already had five verdicts withdrawn for exactly this.
rasterDisposition: This family holds a hash-bound RASTER_PASS over its whole document set. That is one gate. Your read is the other.
stopConditions: CONTROL_STATE.json does not show the transfer completed
you cannot measure an obligation in this environment (return NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE, never a pass)

branchFrom.why: the activated ledger and this assignment live at that commit; branching from an earlier one gives you a ledger where your grant does not exist

withdrawn.reason: This assignment reserved az_marijuana_expungement_arrest_no_charges-set for a second independent read on VF21 and required a Captain transfer first, which was never made and whose captainTransferCommands were never written. The external session was never launched. The family has since been repaired, returned to VERIFY_PENDING and granted to VF02, where a Claude verification team holds it live.
withdrawn.whyNotLeftStanding: A reservation nobody is acting on is indistinguishable from a lost family. E2 refused to let two records claim one subject, which is the guard working.
withdrawn.ifTheExternalReadIsStillWanted: Re-issue after VF02 returns, as a further read on bytes that will by then have moved again.
